solutions.title: Brute force doubled window
solutions.strategy: Try every start in a doubled array while limiting each window to at most n elements.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n starts and each start extends up to n positions.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and the best sum are tracked.

solutions.title: Kadane max/min
solutions.strategy: Compute the best non-wrapping subarray and the best wrapping subarray as total sum minus minimum subarray.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value updates constant-time Kadane states once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only running sums and extrema are stored.
